title: hieracium micracladium
intro: Hieracium micracladium, commonly known as small hawk's beard, is a plant species in the dandelion family. This plant is traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include acting as a diuretic and anti-inflammatory, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, and supporting the digestive system. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium micracladium include stimulating the appetite and aiding in the treatment of various gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
